translations.Jira 紀錄、公告與關鍵溝通證據應依公司紀錄保存政策、法遵要求與本程序保存年限: Jira records, advisories, and evidence of key communications shall be retained according to the company's record retention policy, compliance requirements, and the retention periods defined in this procedure. If other applicable policies or contracts require a longer retention period, the longer period shall apply.
translations.Jira 記錄、附件、決策、公告與通知證據完整: Completeness of Jira records, attachments, decisions, advisories, and notification evidence

translations.Medium/Low 弱點案件得於完整解決方案、維護版本或批次安全更新就緒後採整: Medium/Low vulnerability cases may be disclosed through a consolidated advisory after a complete solution, maintenance release, or batch security update is ready; the advisory shall still clearly list the CVE, affected products / versions, remediation or mitigation methods, release date, and necessary limitations.
translations.Medium/Low 弱點或經核准之批次修復案件，得於完整解決方案、維護版本或批: Medium/Low vulnerabilities or approved batch remediation cases may be disclosed through a consolidated advisory after the complete solution, maintenance release, or batch security update is ready. translations.PM 應就修補規劃提供 release feasibility、版本分支、客戶可: PM shall provide input for remediation planning, including release feasibility, version branches, customer applicability, EOL/EOS strategy, ODM/OEM coordination, customer pre-notification needs, and business/contractual impact. If the information is not yet complete, PM shall first provide known information and uncertainties and continue updating the master Jira case.

RD/DQV is responsible for technical verification and test evidence, while PSIRT is responsible for integrating security risk and process determinations.
translations.PM 應確認發布策略、交付路徑、客戶適用性、release note 可理解性、: PM shall confirm the release strategy, delivery path, customer applicability, release note understandability, customized-version needs, and product lifecycle limitations. Technical validation results shall still be based on RD/DQV/QA/QT evidence.

translations.PM、產品範圍確認時間、客戶/ODM/OEM 影響範圍、EOL/EOS 判定、r: PM, product scope confirmation time, customer/ODM/OEM impact scope, EOL/EOS determination, release path, and customer notification strategy input

translations.PSIRT 與 RD/DQV 應確認案件是否可重現、是否影響產品安全以及是否存在: PSIRT and RD/DQV shall confirm whether the case is reproducible, whether it affects product security, and whether a reasonable attack scenario exists.

translations.SPMO 或指定治理單位應定期召集 PSIRT 檢討案件處理成效、瓶頸與改善措施: SPMO or the designated governance unit shall periodically convene PSIRT to review case handling effectiveness, bottlenecks, and improvement measures.

translations.弱點提供、協調揭露、補件、交互驗證與同步溝通: Vulnerability submission, coordinated disclosure, supplemental information, mutual verification, and synchronized communication

translations.支援期間內之產品應依產品風險建立 security test and revie: Products within the support period shall establish a security test and review plan based on product risk, covering periodic vulnerability scanning, component vulnerability checks, supplier advisory review, threat intelligence review, post-release feedback review, and at least annual product security risk reassessment.
